title: SURVEY OF CRIME Cases reported During the year under review (1967), a total number of 8,81,981 cases of cognizable offences (under the Indian Penal Code) were reported in India as against 7,94,733 during 1966, recording an increase of 11.0% over the previous year. These figures include crimes committed by juveniles. Table 1 presents the comparative position of (i) incidence of total cognizable crime reported, (ii) estimated population and (iii) volume of crime per one hundred thousand of population during the last six years, viz. 1962 to 1967. TABLE I INCIDENCE OF CRIME AND POPULATION DURING 1962 TO 1967 IN INDIA
